title: Importing TileSet in a TileMap layer causes hundreds of `has_alternative_tile` / `create_tile` C++ errors at scene start
body:
### Tested versions

tested in 4.5 stable

### System information

windows 11 . ryzen 5 8600g. godot 4.5 stable

### Issue description

(presumably not hardware related) . there is an error with the tilemaplayer node. after importing the tileset , the debugger gives hundreds of errors (presumably for each (x,y) coordonate in the texture atlas)  , here are the error texts:



 `E 0:00:00:501   has_alternative_tile: The TileSetAtlasSource atlas has no tile at (0, 26).
  <C++ Error>   Condition "!tiles.has(p_atlas_coords)" is true. Returning: false
  <C++ Source>  scene/resources/2d/tile_set.cpp:5438 @ has_alternative_tile()`

and 
`E 0:00:00:501   create_tile: Cannot create tile. The tile is outside the texture or tiles are already present in the space the tile would cover.
  <C++ Error>   Condition "!room_for_tile" is true.
  <C++ Source>  scene/resources/2d/tile_set.cpp:4986 @ create_tile()`



this is an issue that is persistent across all godot 4.5 projects ive created that use a tilemaplayer node. it gives the errors when the scene is started no matter what is on it as long as the tilemaplayer has a tileset imported. tried different tilesets and the only difference was less errors (150 compared to 401) . it does not affect the game itself, but the errors appear in the debugger.


### Steps to reproduce

1- in a new godot project create a tilemaplayer node
2- import any tileset
3- start the game


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22440580/test.zip)
